description: Tightly scoped: Renovate only watches the LLM e2e harness's pinned Claude Code CLI version, test/e2e-llm/package.json — the only npm manifest in this repo. No other deps are managed here. SOL-152586 briefly extended this to also cover Go modules and GitHub Actions instead of using Dependabot, since Dependabot cannot satisfy the DCO sign-off gate on its own — but Renovate cannot be enrolled for a public repository under the org's current system, so that extension was reverted (SOL-152808). Go modules and GitHub Actions are covered by .github/dependabot.yml instead, with Dependabot's PRs exempted from the DCO gate at the workflow level (.github/workflows/dco.yaml) rather than via a sign-off Renovate can attach and Dependabot cannot. The ignorePaths below is more load-bearing now than it was before the revert, not less: config:base resolves to config:recommended, which folds in :ignoreModulesAndTests, whose own ignorePaths covers `**/test/**` among others — a pattern that matches test/e2e-llm/package.json. The single top-level ignorePaths here replaces that list rather than extending it, and that replacement is the only reason Renovate sees the CLI pin at all. Before the revert, dropping it as apparent redundancy would have silently lost two of three jobs; now it would silently switch off the only job this config exists for, with no signal that anything changed. Bumps follow npm's `stable` dist-tag (deliberately lagged from `latest`); see test/e2e-llm/README.md for the bump procedure. Top-level `commitBody` carries the DCO sign-off that the `DCO sign-off` CI gate requires, and is top-level rather than per-rule so it also covers lock-file maintenance and config-migration branches. The gate exempts nobody *by forging a commit's author field*: an author-name exemption would be forgeable with `git commit --author`. The address must match the identity Renovate commits under (the hosted GitHub App uses this one), otherwise its PRs go red on the gate — the fix is to correct the address here, never to exempt the bot.

prBodyNotes: Before merging: run `./run-all.sh` twice from `test/e2e-llm/` against the candidate version, confirm 16/16 pass both times. See the README's bump procedure.
